name: Bokura ga Hirotta Ecchi na Ningyou
original_name: 僕らが拾ったエッチな人形
source:
Two boys find an extremely realistic female doll, take it to their secret hideout,
and have some fun with its body.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ325255.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
兩個男孩撿到一個做得極其逼真的女性人偶，把它帶回秘密基地，拿它的身體尋樂。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ325255.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
